players.product: discretes, power MOSFETs and PCIe clock / switch ICs for servers

quarterly_data.signal: Investor deck (Exhibit 99.3) breaks down Diodes' AI data center content opportunity per box: server motherboard $109, server power solution $50, network switch $73 and storage and interconnect $35, totalling $267. On the AI server motherboard (+ AI accelerator + NIC) platform the $109 SAM splits into analog/power management $22.00, discrete $20.00 and timing and connectivity $67.00, with timing solutions that meet the jitter performance of PCIe 7.0; on a data center network switch the $73.00 splits into analog and power management $17.00, discrete $5.00 and timing and connectivity $51.00. Products named include PCIe packet switches, PCIe / USB / SATA ReDrivers, clock generators, buffers and oscillators, and power management (MOSFETs, LDOs, TVS, DC-DC, isolation, gate drivers); the deck also lists high-voltage 60-100V LDOs and DC-DC for 48V rails.
quarterly_data.figure: AI data center content per box $267 = server motherboard $109 + server power $50 + network switch $73 + storage/interconnect $35; motherboard: analog/power $22.00, discrete $20.00, timing/connectivity $67.00; network switch: analog/power $17.00, discrete $5.00, timing/connectivity $51.00

quarterly_data.signal: Results deck (Exhibit 99.2) spells out the 3-year targets for 2028: $2B revenue, gross profit of $700M, gross margin of 35%+ and non-GAAP EPS of $4.00+. The deck says future margin expansion will be driven by an increasing contribution from higher-margin automotive, industrial and data center end markets, new products and improved loading across manufacturing facilities. The proposed ElevATE Semiconductor acquisition was then expected to close in late 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: 2028 targets: $2B revenue, $700M gross profit, 35%+ gross margin, $4.00+ non-GAAP EPS
